naming.files: preserve the source basename, replace .zig with .go
naming.symbols: split underscores and title-case components; prefix free declarations with the title-cased source basename unless already equal; methods are PrefixedReceiver.Symbol
naming.unexported: all translated production symbols remain exported until the differential migration is complete

errors.error_union: A Zig !T result becomes (T, error); !void becomes error
errors.concrete_errors: Each Zig error-set member becomes a package-level sentinel created with errors.New; callers use errors.Is
errors.ordinary_failure: Return a concrete sentinel or wrapped error with %w; never encode failure in a zero value
errors.panic: Use panic only for a source @panic, unreachable invariant, or allocation failure on an infallible source path
errors.fatal: Return an error up to commandapp; only commandapp prints it and selects the process exit status

optionals.pointer: A Zig optional pointer becomes a nil-capable Go pointer
optionals.lookup: A lookup-style optional return becomes (value, bool)
optionals.stored_scalar: A stored optional scalar becomes a struct with Value and Valid fields
optionals.error_absence: Absence becomes an error only when the Zig API already distinguishes it as an error

tagged_unions.representation: Use one struct containing a Kind enum plus one field per payload variant
tagged_unions.construction: Generate one constructor per payload variant; validate that inactive payload fields are zero
tagged_unions.dispatch: Use an exhaustive switch on Kind with a default that returns or panics InvalidKind according to the source contract

ownership.allocators: Do not translate allocator parameters; Go owns ordinary objects through reachability
ownership.borrowed_slices: Borrowed Zig slices become string or []byte and must not be retained
ownership.owned_slices: Owned Zig slices become a copied []byte or []T at the ownership boundary
ownership.arena: Arena-owned graph data remains owned by the interpreter/heap object and is released by Reset
ownership.resources: Resources implement io.Closer and remain in the stable-ID resource table until explicit Close or interpreter Reset

strings.bytes: Protocol, source, and arbitrary file content use []byte
strings.nul_terminated: No internal NUL-terminated representation; append a terminator only inside a platform syscall adapter
strings.encoding: Do not normalize Unicode; preserve input bytes unless an existing UTF-8 operation explicitly decodes them

numbers.enum: Use the exact signedness and width declared by the Zig enum; enums without an explicit width use int32
numbers.integer_cast: Use checked conversion helpers at every narrowing or signedness boundary
numbers.float: f64 becomes float64; preserve IEEE-754 behavior and reject non-finite values where the source does

cleanup.defer: Translate each defer to a Go defer at the same acquisition point; Go LIFO order must match Zig
cleanup.errdefer: Use a named error result and deferred closure guarded by err != nil
cleanup.close_errors: Return the first close error only when the source observes it; otherwise explicitly discard it
cleanup.rollback: Checkpoint restoration is a deferred closure disabled only after commit

build.options: Generate internal/buildcfg/config.go containing Version, VersionDate, Host, ReduceTrace, and Strict
build.defaults: Defaults must match build.zig exactly; tests override through constructors, never process environment
build.platform_tags: Use //go:build darwin || linux for POSIX implementations and filename suffixes _amd64.go/_arm64.go for architecture-specific code
build.unsupported: Unsupported operating systems or architectures fail at build time because no platform implementation satisfies the interface

tests.unit_location: Place tests beside the translated file in <target>_test.go
tests.fixtures: Reuse tests/oracle/fixtures, tests/golden, and tests/reference without rewriting expected data

translation_loop: Select the lexicographically first pending unit whose dependencies are complete
Translate only that unit and its Go tests
Run go run ./cmd/checkdag and go generate ./... && git diff --exit-code
Set only that unit status to complete
Continue only when every preceding command is green
After each package boundary run all stage_oracle commands for completed units
Build the final executable only after all required units are complete
Run the full Zig-reference differential gate against the Go executable

zig_test_companion.replacement: Translated production-unit tests in adjacent _test.go files

zig_benchmark_harness.replacement: Go benchmarks in translated package _test.go files
